positions.frame: what must the derive-id E2E test case reproduce and guarantee?
positions.why: Both expressions describe the same test case from two angles: src-1 fixes what prior failure state the test must reproduce (the prod missing-id pattern on a ## heading), src-2 states the required outcome once that state is hit (no crash, valid slug). Read together they define a single test's design — the negative precondition and the positive postcondition of derive-id behavior. Power/register reads support this: src-1 speaks from expert citation of a known defect, src-2 speaks as a hard constraint on the fix — a diagnose-then-guarantee pairing, not two independent claims.

placements.why: Both segments describe a test built specifically to reproduce a known production defect and verify its resolution (no crash, valid slug output) — this is verification/guarantee-of-fix content, not opportunity, strategy, product, architecture, org, or template material. No strata category exists yet in this repo, and nothing in the empty structure covers this organizational function, so a new top-level category is minted for it rather than folding proof-of-fix content into an unrelated tier.
placements.title: From asserted fix to demonstrated guarantee
placements.frame: What reproducible test evidence establishes that a claimed fix actually holds under the exact failure conditions that broke it in production?

placements.title: Derive-id correctness is proven against the exact shape of its prior production failure
placements.frame: What prior failure state must this test reproduce, and what postcondition must it guarantee, for the derive-id logic to be trusted going forward?
placements.why: src-1 fixes the negative precondition the test must reproduce — the exact prod missing-id pattern on a ## heading with no id field — and src-2 fixes the positive postcondition once that state is hit — must not crash, must produce a valid slug. Together they define a single recurring theme future derive-id test envelopes will keep feeding: what failure shapes must be reproduced and what guarantees must hold once fixed. This is thematic (a subject for accumulating test coverage), not a one-time fact, so it earns its own leaf rather than being folded as evidence under a broader unrelated theme — none exists in the currently empty graph structure to hold it. Placed under the newly minted Proof strata since it is the concrete test-coverage subject that category exists to hold.
